# Class decks

One deck per class, `ARC3133_ClassNN.pptx` and `.pdf`. Each is generated by `src/classNN.py` with the course slide kit (`src/nb.py`, `src/slidekit.py`); dates, due lines and requirements are read from `syllabus/course.yml`, so rebuild the decks after changing the source:

```text
cd slides/src
DECK_OUT=.. python classNN.py
cd .. && soffice --headless --convert-to pdf ARC3133_ClassNN.pptx
```

The `*_CKS` files are Christine Khouri Sader's section variants and are not generated. Readiness is tracked under `presentation_review` in the curriculum source and in the [teaching material register](../reference/Teaching_Material_Register.md).
